neighbours.label: the continuation of a sentence that opens 'The following …' to announce rules, conditions or a list (e.g. 'The following items … will result in', '… apply unless')
fire: Please read carefully. The following actions are prohibited and will result in a permanent ban from the forum.
In this agreement the following terms have the meanings given below unless the context otherwise requires.
Before you apply, note that the following documents are required to obtain a new license.
For this course, the following behaviours are not permitted and will lead to removal from class.
The following conditions must be met before any refund can be issued by the store.
According to the handbook, the following expenses are not covered and will be charged to the employee.
In the table below the following abbreviations are used throughout the report.
The following rules apply to all visitors and failure to follow them will result in a fine.
quiet: Please read carefully. Posting spam on the forum can get your account banned for good.
In this agreement a member means any person who has paid the yearly fee.
Before you apply, bring your passport and a utility bill to the office.
For this course, students who skip three classes may be asked to leave.
Refunds are issued by the store within two weeks of the purchase date.
According to the handbook, employees pay for their own meals while travelling.
In the table below we list the yearly totals for each region.
All visitors to the park should stay on the marked paths at all times.

notes: card top examples mix rule/definition boilerplate; probes fired only when 'The following' framed the sentence
